DEFENDANT SHALL PRODUCE AND VERIFY THAT ALL RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. DEFENDANT SHALL PRODUCE AND VERIFY THAT ALL RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. AS TO REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION NO. 29, WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER DEFENDANT SHALL VERIFY THAT AFTER SEARCH AND INQUIRY, NO RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS EXIST.
